result.generation_response: The document outlines the 2014-15 Budget Projections for a school with 520 students. Total revenue is $5,461,160, sourced from state/local per pupil funding ($4,346,160), Title I/II/IDEA grants ($805,000), ERATE ($75,000), LA-4 program funding ($185,000), and donations ($50,000). Key expenditures include Salaries ($2,709,910) covering administration, instructional, and non-instructional staff; Employee Benefits ($668,711.57) including health insurance, retirement, and social security; Purchased Professional Services ($271,609) for legal, accounting, and technical services; Purchased Property Services ($995,359) for utilities, facility usage, and maintenance; and Other Purchased Services ($640,475) covering transportation, insurance, food service, and travel.

The document presents the 2014-15 Budget Projections for James M. Singleton Charter School. It details two expenditure categories: Supplies (Object Code 600), totaling $95,095.43 — covering materials and supplies ($42,295.43), food & commodities ($2,500), books and periodicals ($35,300), and custodial supplies ($15,000); and Other Use of Funds (Object Code 900), totaling $80,000 — including depreciation ($15,000) and indirect cost ($65,000), with no contingency allocated. The school's total projected expenditures amount to $5,461,160.00.

The document outlines the 2012-2013 Program Budget Assumptions for James Singleton Charter School. Key assumptions include: a student enrollment of 620 (MFP count) and 40 (LA4); an MFP allocation of $8,368 per pupil (State and Local) and $5,632.60 per pupil for LA4; a teacher-to-student ratio of 22:1; a Federal Funds Allocation (Title I, Title II, IDEA B) of $805,000, representing 90% of the 2013-14 allocation pending BESE approval; and a school calendar of 182–192 instructional days.
